dedupe_keys.name: vehicle to infrastructure ieee 802 11ad wi fi traces

description: This collection measures vehicle-to-infrastructure communications using IEEE 802.11ad Wi-Fi around a residential intersection in Vila Nova de Gaia, Portugal. Instituto de Telecomunicações and Vassar College researchers use a stationary access point, a moving client and a monitoring radio based on TP-Link Talon AD7200 equipment. Experiments from 2020 and 2021 record throughput, positions and detailed frame information along straight and circuit routes. Zenodo provides the space- and time-indexed CSV traces in a ZIP archive free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is one intersection and equipment configuration, with individual traces lasting seconds to minutes. The limited geometry and repeated driving patterns constrain extrapolation to city-wide availability. A reviewer-assessed use is validating antenna-sector selection or mobility-dependent communications performance in road-network simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related simulator, without verified trace conversion. No trace archive or linked collection and analysis code was executed.
name: Vehicle-to-infrastructure IEEE 802.11ad Wi-Fi traces
